verdict.rationale: The evidence shows autonomous agentic workflows (screening and transaction monitoring agents, auto-remediation of level 1 alerts) and LLM-friendly documentation (llms.txt, markdown docs). It never documents a way for users to operate the product through natural-language commands or prompts. Background AI agents and machine-readable docs are adjacent features or developer building blocks, not a natural-language control interface.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
